{{Top|leg}}
'''Mood fur''' was the fur of the [[Kushiban]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The fur changed [[Color/Legends|colors]] according to the Kushiban's mood; among the colors it could display were white for calm and black for deep despair.<ref name="POTJp">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref>
